reference.pathophysiology: Dysregulated infection response crashes pressure with mottling, oliguria and lactate while prolonged unexplained fever with nodes and spleen sorts into kala-azar, lymphoma, TB and abscess; line and catheter infections yield to removal and bundles while cultures before antibiotics steer de-escalation.
additionalDifferentials: Lymphoma versus kala-azar versus TB versus endocarditis by biopsy rK39 granulomas and Dukes
Sepsis versus cardiogenic versus anaphylaxis by cultures lactate and exposure
CAUTI versus CLABSI versus VAP by colony tips and infiltrates
additionalInvestigations: Paired blood cultures with lactate clearance
Urine line-tip with PET biopsy stepwise
